added_note: The agent and its package belong to the Copilot Studio Gallery and its authors. This library added a made-up healthcare dataset the agent can answer from, a one-file version you can run on your own computer with a workshop, sample questions, and proof that it imports into a fresh environment. Everything on this page above "From the authors" is ours.
headline: Catch the contract mistakes before the lawyer has to
capabilities: Check a contract against itself for clashing clauses, broken references and blanks
Check it against the organization's own contract policies
Check it against current law, citing official sources only
Return findings for a legal professional to confirm, never as legal advice
outcomes: Fewer drafting mistakes reach legal review
Reviewers start from a ranked list of findings
why_try: The demo shows the agent reviewing a made-up clinic services agreement that has mistakes planted in it, with nothing pasted into the chat.

sample_prompts.label: Contracts Manager: See what is on file
sample_prompts.prompt: Which sample contract and which contract policies do you have on file? Answer in under 80 words.

sample_prompts.label: Contracts Manager: Check the contract against itself
sample_prompts.prompt: Run the Internal Consistency Review on sample contract AG-MSA-2026-014 from your knowledge and give me the summary table in chat. Do not produce a file.

sample_prompts.label: Legal Reviewer: Check it against company policy
sample_prompts.prompt: Now check the same contract against the Alder Grove Clinics contract policies on file. Give me a short table: policy, clause, conflict. Do not produce a file and do not search the web.

synthetic_data.note: One fictional clinic group, seven contract policies and one sample agreement with planted mistakes.
